consequence.statement: Traefik will fail to start if Rancher v1 provider configuration (providers.rancher) is present in the static configuration.
consequence.remediation: Remove all Rancher v1 provider configuration from static configuration and migrate to the Kubernetes CRD provider for Rancher 2.x deployments.

original.statement: The Rancher v1 provider has been removed in Traefik v3; configurations using it will prevent Traefik from starting.

decision.reason: [ev-96141bfb2be5] says that in v3 the Rancher v1 provider configuration (providers.rancher, [providers.rancher], --providers.rancher=true) "is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start". Leaving the configuration in place therefore makes the upgraded Traefik fail to start, so mandatory work is needed. The remediation matches the guide: remove all Rancher provider configuration from the static configuration and use the Kubernetes CRD provider for Rancher 2.x. A proxy that fails to start makes critical severity reasonable, and upgrade-blocked (the upgrade fails on an unmet precondition) fits.
